title: Who to trust? The arbiter as a state machine
summary: Write NAVERA Lite's real judge as a state machine: who may compete, who wins, how long a returning source must wait, and a door that refuses impossible fixes for good, so that a fix stamped in the future can never come back. Race it live on ROS against the course's reference, then measure the price of the hold-off, of the freshness window and of fusion.
